resources.string: Turn loose thoughts into publishable cards
I will keep updating the draft while reasoning. You can follow the trace or wait for the result.
Analysis finished. Tap to expand the trace.
You can keep typing, or add an image first
Add one tag at a time, e.g. cafe
Add a fuller summary and send
Type a clear title and send
Choose an edit action below first
Say anything. I will shape it into a card.
Your input will sync into the draft immediately
Sending will update the current draft immediately
Choose an edit action below first
Type a new title and send
Tell me the idea, memory, or task. I will draft it first, then help you finish the rest step by step.
The draft is ready. I put the key parts below, and you can publish after a quick check.
The content is already organized. Adding one image will make the card feel complete, but you can continue without it.
I already pulled out the main idea. A few tags will make it easier to find later, but skipping is also fine.
The content is taking shape. Give it a clear title and we can move on.
Tag added: %1$s. All info is ready. You can review now.
Added “%1$s”. Keep adjusting tags, or go back to review.
No image selected. Continue the next step below.
Added %1$d image(s). The draft already feels more complete.
The images are synced. Add more, replace them, or clear them below.
Skipped image step. Continue the next step below.
Skipped tag step. Continue the next step below.
Skipped field: %1$s. Continue the next step below.
The draft is ready. Publish if it already looks right, or tap a field below to adjust it.
Tell me how you want it changed and I will update the draft directly.
Type the new title below. When you are done, you can go back to review.
Switched to manual edit. Enter title first, then publish.
Title updated. Keep editing, or go back to review.
Tap a suggested tag, or type one new tag below. When you are done, go back to review.
Type a better summary below. When you are done, go back to review.
Type a place directly, or tap an example below. When you are done, go back to review.
Summary updated. Keep editing, or go back to review.
Removed “%1$s”. Keep adjusting tags, or go back to review.
Location updated to “%1$s”. Keep editing, or go back to review.
Location cleared. You can add a new one, or go back to review.
Saved locally. You can come back and finish it later.
Published “%1$s”. Want to capture something else next?
Publishing now. I am handling the final step.
New session started. Enter content to capture.
This step works better with the actions below, or with the specific input I am asking for.
Tap the item you want to adjust below, then enter the new content inside that editor.
Add an image to make the card feel complete
%1$d image(s) are ready. Want to adjust them?
You can upload now, or simply keep going if you do not have an image yet.
Adding, replacing, or clearing images keeps you here. Go back to review when you decide you are done.
There is no image yet. Any new image you pick will appear here immediately.
Pick a few tags so this is easier to find later
The tags are already organized. Tap one to remove it.
Suggested tags and custom tags can be used together.
You can also type one new tag below
Give this capture a title that is easy to understand at a glance
Add a fuller summary so the card is easier to revisit later
Add a place so it is easier to search later
Type in the bottom input bar and send. I will sync the change into the draft right away.
Tap any part you want to improve
Each item shows the current value, so you can jump straight into the right editor.
You can also save the draft now and finish it later.
This one is done. Want to start another capture?
A new capture starts with a fresh draft and will not affect what you just finished.
Take a quick look at the preview
Check the cover, copy, and metadata first, then edit the field you want.
On small screens, tap the preview button near the composer, then come back and edit.
Add a place so this is easier to find later
The place is set. Want to make it more precise?
Type a city, district, landmark, or venue name, or tap an example below. The more concrete it is, the easier it will be to find later.
Update it with a fuller place name, or clear it and add a new one.
No place is attached yet. Add a city, district, landmark, or venue so the capture is easier to revisit later.
e.g. a cafe on Yuyuan Road
Switching here affects the next analysis request immediately.
The provider shortcut is hidden. You can turn it back on in AI Provider settings.
Keep drafting and editing without AI analysis.
Use the server path first for a steadier experience.
Talk straight to a local or external model for experimentation.
